revision_forms.git: git:<exact 40-hex repository commit>; read the source path from that commit without writing it back
revision_forms.sha256: sha256:<exact lowercase 64-hex content digest>; verify exact repository file bytes
revision_forms.declared: Exact document revision value; schema files instead use a content hash

identity_check: A source pointer is a locator. Match any available source identity independently; a locator alone does not assign responsibility, scope, approval or authority.
